title: Stratified dialog probe audit harness for cost-apply safety
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an automated audit harness that validates quality preservation when applying batching/cache recommendations. The harness will run stratified dialog probes (diverse conversational slices) against candidate config changes in shadow and staged apply modes, compute a battery of semantic and task-specific fidelity metrics, surface statistically-significant deltas, and gate automatic rollouts with human-in-the-loop approvals. Goal is to enable safe, measurable cost tuning with low false positives and clear remediation paths.
acceptance_criteria: Harness executes stratified probe sets across all target model+seq-length combos in <90m for nightly runs
For a candidate config change, harness produces a human-friendly report with: aggregate semantic delta, top 10 regressions by conversational slice, and suggested rollback reason codes
Automated gate rules implemented: immediate rollback if semantic-similarity drop > 0.08 (95% CI) on critical slices; quarantine and human review if drop between 0.03 and 0.08
Shadow canary pipeline integrated with deployment service: shadow-run comparison data stored in perf+trace dashboard and linked in report
Playbook updated with actionable steps (runbook link), and two engineers trained on audit flow
End-to-end tests validate that a deliberately injected regression triggers quarantine and human approval flow
